name: 瓦尔特·盖拉赫
bio_short: 德国物理学家。他最著名的成就是与奥托·斯特恩（Otto Stern）合作进行了“斯特恩-盖拉赫实验”（`stern_gerlach_1922`），该实验为量子力学中的空间量子化提供了决定性的实验证据。
bio_short_en: A German physicist. He is best known for his collaboration with Otto Stern on the 'Stern-Gerlach experiment' (`stern_gerlach_1922`), which provided the definitive experimental proof for spatial quantization in quantum mechanics.
